products.name: Freepik AI
products.note: Stock image AI generation; commercial licensing; EU-hosted; content moderation

reading.body:
Freepik's AI product sits in the Image and Graphic Design category, offering stock image generation with commercial licensing, content moderation, and EU-based hosting.

The EU-hosting detail is the most operationally significant fact here. Hosting within the EU implies compliance with European data-residency and regulatory requirements, which shapes where the underlying compute infrastructure must physically sit. That is a building and power constraint, not just a legal one: the servers generating these images must be located in jurisdictions with specific grid and facility characteristics.

The data does not include model size, training compute, energy consumption, or infrastructure partners, so no claims can be made about Freepik's position in the broader AI scaling picture. What is recorded is a narrow product profile: a generation tool aimed at commercial users who need licensable image output with moderation controls attached.
